_comment: Thresholds for anomaly tagging + the verbose-trace sampling tiers. Safe to tune without code changes; the server reads this fresh on each interaction.

verbosityTiers._comment: Rolling interactions/hour -> probability [0-1] of a full detailed trace for a normal (non-anomalous) interaction. First matching maxInteractionsPerHour wins. Anomalous/error interactions are always traced regardless of tier.

abuseHeuristics._comment: Simple in-memory /api/run rate tracking, not exact across restarts/replicas by design.
